children: On 14 September 2026, the following awards were granted to Directors and persons discharging managerial responsibilities over either Ordinary Shares or American Depositary Shares as follows:
1.     options under the Diageo 2023 Long Term Incentive Plan which are exercisable on 14 September 2029;
2.     conditional awards in the form of Restricted Stock Units under the Diageo 2023 Long Term Incentive Plan, subject to the satisfaction of performance conditions, where indicated; and
3.     conditional awards in the form of Restricted Stock Units under the Diageo Exceptional Stock Award Plan.
The notifications below, which have been made in accordance with the requirement of the UK Market Abuse Regulation, provide further details.
